extraction_notes: Used only Doc23 Raw + components raw image, overlay, and provided crop images; no Ground Truth, OCR engines, Raw+wires folders, or outside resources were used.
Raw schematic was treated as authoritative; overlay images were used only as component-location aids.
Legend in raw_18/raw_40: heavy solid lines are power, short dashed lines control/interlock, long dashed lines instrument/metering, light solid lines grounding, black dots are electrical nodes.
Heavy horizontal bars are represented as bus nodes; bus edges are only asserted to direct taps/devices/feeders, not expanded into same-net cliques.
Crossings without black dots were rejected as non-connections.
PNL-* in the 480 V load centers is assigned to the plus/cross panel symbol adjacent to MCC-*-3; some printed PNL labels are visually close to the MCC-*-3 label.
1C, 2A, 2C, and 2B incoming feeder origins use visible routed conductors from the ESF bus areas; plausible alternatives are kept in uncertain_edges.
Lower DC/UPS/RPS dashed networks are dense; directly visible relay/annunciator/recorder/panel links were asserted, with lower confidence where dashed bundles crowd together.
